claim_boundary: The certificate derives the covariant internal current, fixes the SU(2) volume, proves the nonzero clock momentum, audits the fixed-coupling stationary family, and derives Omega_total(delta,L_D)=omega delta Q_R on the Berger background. It does not establish whether an allowed fixed-coupling linearized tangent has delta Q_R nonzero, so it assigns no total D verdict.

clock_interpretation.interpretation: The rotating phase carries a nonzero conserved global O(2) momentum and is therefore a genuine matter clock candidate, not a cost-free scalar gauge label.

conventions.authoritative_matter_action: S_m=int sqrt(-g){-(1/2) sum_A nabla T_A.nabla T_A -(R/12) rho^2 -(lambda/4) rho^4}
conventions.maurer_cartan_volume: V_0=int sigma_1 wedge sigma_2 wedge sigma_3=16 pi^2
conventions.scalar_presymplectic_convention: Omega_Sigma=sum_A int delta(sqrt(h) n.nabla T_A) wedge delta T_A

covariant_current_audit.improvement_cross_term: ZERO because delta_R g=0 and delta_R(T_1^2+T_2^2)=0
covariant_current_audit.internal_current: j_R^mu=T_1 nabla^mu T_2-T_2 nabla^mu T_1 up to the declared future-density orientation
covariant_current_audit.scalar_potential: theta_m^mu(delta T)=-sum_A nabla^mu T_A delta T_A plus the metric-only conformal-improvement potential

fixed_coupling_audit.scale_direction: a is the common Weyl scale; Q_R is independent of a
fixed_coupling_audit.warning: The open q interval is a family across coupling products alpha_B lambda, not a physical tangent inside one fixed theory.

helical_presymplectic_audit.decision_rule: D is non-null iff the fixed-coupling allowed tangent space contains a delta with delta Q_R nonzero.
helical_presymplectic_audit.identity: Omega_total(delta,L_D)=omega delta Q_R for every allowed linearized tangent delta at the background
